# August 2026

> August 2026 release notes for Automation Cloud and Test Cloud.

This page provides an overview of all UiPath platform and product releases for August 2026 across all Automation Cloud and Test Cloud environments.

## Automation Cloud and Test Cloud

### Late August 2026

| Publishing date | Release timeframe |
| --- | --- |
| August 31, 2026 | August 16, 2026 – August 31, 2026 |

#### Release highlights

The following sections outline some release highlights for UiPath products deployed under Automation Cloud in the August 16, 2026 – August 31, 2026 timeframe.

**Automation Cloud Administration and Test Cloud Administration**

* In-app notification retention is now limited to 30 days; older notifications are no longer available regardless of topic.
* Administrators can now grant more than one AI and Agentic usage top-up to a user in a single action from the **User usage** dashboard.

**Test Manager**

* The iText PDF library dependency was removed: reading PDF attachments in the cloud is now text-only (breaking change).

### Early August 2026

| Publishing date | Release timeframe |
| --- | --- |
| August 15, 2026 | August 1, 2026 – August 15, 2026 |

#### Release highlights

The following sections outline some release highlights for UiPath products deployed under Automation Cloud in the August 1, 2026 – August 15, 2026 timeframe.

##### Agents

* Agents can now use coded functions as tools.
* The **gemini-3.5-flash** model is now available for Agents.

##### Orchestrator

* Google Cloud Storage is available as a new storage bucket provider, authenticated with a service account key.
* The default API specification is now the OpenAPI 3.0 Public profile. The previous V20 specification is deprecated.
